title: Curated knowledge universe
description: A compact, source-backed network connecting energy, agriculture, technology, transportation, climate, economics, healthcare, and manufacturing.

edges.mechanism: Natural gas is burned in turbines and combined-cycle plants to generate electricity supplied to the grid.
The industrial sector uses natural gas as both fuel and feedstock to produce fertilizer and other chemicals.

edges.relation: supports crop yields and operating economics
edges.mechanism: Fertilizer is a critical input for most field crops and materially affects yields, operating costs, and profitability.
Agricultural productivity determines how much output is produced from land, labor, capital, and material inputs; productivity growth has made food more abundant and cheaper.
Data centers are a growing electricity load, with U.S. consumption projected by DOE to rise substantially through 2028.
Semiconductors underpin AI and advanced computing systems, including the compute infrastructure deployed in data centers.
Critical materials including gallium and germanium are used in semiconductor technologies.
Lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite, and other critical materials are inputs to lithium-ion battery technologies.
Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in electric vehicles and provide their onboard energy storage.
Lithium-ion batteries are also used for grid-scale energy storage, allowing electricity to be stored and supplied later.
Combustion of petroleum fuels in cars, trucks, aircraft, rail, and other transport produces substantial greenhouse gas emissions.
Electric vehicles replace or supplement internal-combustion propulsion within the transportation system.
The accumulation of human-caused greenhouse gases changes Earth’s energy balance and is the primary driver of observed climate change.
Climate change is making extreme heat events more frequent and intense.
Extreme heat can cause heat stroke and is associated with cardiovascular, kidney, respiratory, and cerebrovascular illness.
Heat waves increase electricity demand as homes and businesses use air conditioning and other cooling equipment.
Changes in temperature, precipitation, pests, and ecosystem services affect crop development, yield, and agricultural productivity.
